transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work. I work with jewelry. Sometimes a customer will ask me a simple question, like... when a ring repair will be ready. And I just... my answer kind of goes everywhere. 

I'll start talking about the invoices... and then somehow it turns into garden soil... or mortgage papers. I don't really know why. I can just see them losing me. So... I'm here.
Have you recently been sleeping less than usual without feeling tired?
No, I don't think so. I sleep about the same as I always do.
Have you been hearing voices that other people do not hear?

I... well, sometimes. Mostly when it's just me in the shop. I'll hear a woman's voice... just muttering my name from back in the polishing room. And sometimes I'll smell something like burning metal, even though all the torches are off. It's... it feels real enough that I usually go back there to check. But no one's there.
How long have you been hearing the woman's voice?

I guess... maybe a year and eight months? Somewhere around there. That's when the voice started, and... the smells. And... well, some other things too, like worrying about people watching us. But yeah, about a year and eight months.
Have these experiences continued for at least two weeks during a time when you were neither depressed nor unusually energized or euphoric?

I guess... yeah. There was a stretch before I got really down... before the depression really settled in. I was still running my jewelry classes, keeping up with the gardening. Just going about my day. But... for a few weeks during that time, I kept hearing those noises from the polishing room. And... just worrying that customers were watching the business. So... yes, I suppose so.
When you say the depression settled in, did you feel depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Yes... I suppose so. Most mornings, I just... wake up with this flat, heavy sadness. It's like the color has drained out of the house before I even get to the shop. It's just... there. Every day.
Since the voices and other unusual experiences began, has your depression been present for most of that time?

I suppose... yeah. Most of the time, I guess. It hasn't just been a bad week here or there. It's... the heavy feeling, the not sleeping well, not wanting to eat... just feeling guilty about everything. It's just kind of been there... most days, for most of the time all this has been happening.
When you are feeling depressed, do the voice and worries that people are watching the business continue?

Yeah... they do. Um... when things were at their worst, the really heavy sadness... and just not caring about anything... that was happening at the same time. I was still... hearing my name in the shop. And I just... I felt so sure that the customers were checking up on our payments. So... yes, they happen together.
